text.text_excerpt: To my pleasant surprise I stumbled upon this food truck outside of an event I was attending at the Joy Theater. With my love for cheese this was right up my alley. There were so many choices to choose from that I was stumped at the window. I went with the Mollie that consisted of goat cheese, bacon, tomato, avocado on a toasted croissant. It was great. To bad my lady friend showed up and I gave up half the sandwich to her, lol. This is instantly one of my favorite food trucks.

Solid food truck option at the medical center! I have tried frencheeze twice and have been pleasantly surprised with their food (I'm not sure why because I'm obsessed with cheese). I really really love their fries. They have Parmesan, truffle oil, and aioli on them... Yum!!!! I also tried their bootz grilled cheese, which is cheddar, Colby, and Swiss on sourdough. While I liked the sandwich, it was a little too heavy and the cheeses didn't quite have enough flavor for me. I'll be back to try a different grilled cheese option (and of course to get more of their fries!) Food -- 4 stars Price -- 4.5 stars Service -- 4.5 stars

I finally got to try this food truck outside NOMA one evening with my Mom. We had the Bootz and the Rachel. The Rachel was the definite winner of the two; it had pesto, truffle aioli, provolone, smoked gouda and tomato. The Bootz was good too (colby, swiss & cheddar on sourdough) but it was just pale in comparison to the Rachel. Two sandwiches were the best of both worlds though so we could each have a half. Price point was good and the sandwiches came up quickly. Will definitely hit them up again for cheesie goodness.
